premises.text: Token-based login is irritating and security must not sacrifice seamless user experience
premises.evidence_span: Some of you already need an irritating token in order to get in

premises.text: Patent-pending ultrasonic audio signals between computer and phone confirm proximity and encode a unique encrypted session key
premises.evidence_span: our unique patent-pending technology, which connects the two devices using audio signals

premises.text: The solution runs in the browser, needs no new hardware for users or data centers, and supports all endpoints and mobile devices
premises.evidence_span: Because we can run entirely in the browser, that makes us completely platform agnostic

premises.text: Enterprises can mark allowed and blocked login geographies for identity and access management policies
premises.evidence_span: mark the areas you want them to log in from, mark the areas you want to block

premises.text: No-hardware simple implementation yields a cost-effective product for financial institutes and large enterprises
premises.evidence_span: we can provide our customers a very superior and cost-effective product

value.text: Uncompromising security with an unbelievable seamless login experience that people love
